structure: CSharp products are struct-table entries and mutable function parameters use one ptr in both primary and additional ABI positions. Parameter binding stores that pointer as the mutable struct slot.
branches: SLG isNominalStruct deliberately excludes products. The shared mutableBorrowUsesStructPointer predicate must separately accept canonical typeKind10. Do not broaden the global nominal predicate, dictionary/array identities, readonly references or sums.
logic: functions signature/entry loading, call argument pointer emission, mutable root pointer and projected member writes all consume mutableBorrowUsesStructPointer; adding product there preserves one authoritative ABI decision.
diagnostics: The preceding declaration fix admits product kind10 exactly as CSharp IsStruct; unsupported scalar/slice/sum storage rejection remains. Existing heap push diagnostic ordering and canonical member place remain unchanged.
